scripts.check: pnpm check:md && pnpm check:ts && pnpm check:rs && pnpm check:py && pnpm check:meta
scripts.fix: pnpm fix:md && pnpm fix:ts && pnpm fix:rs && pnpm fix:py
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check python/ scripts/ && uv run ruff format --check python/ scripts/
scripts.fix:py: uv run ruff check --fix python/ scripts/ && uv run ruff format python/ scripts/
scripts.check:cross: cargo run -q -p netwave --example dump oracle/tmp && uv run --project python python python/scripts/dump.py oracle/tmp && node typescript/scripts/dump.mjs oracle/tmp && python3 oracle/compare_cross.py oracle/tmp && python3 scripts/check_vocab_types.py && python3 scripts/check_verbs.py
scripts.check:meta: python3 scripts/check_license.py && python3 scripts/check_ci.py && python3 scripts/check_vocab.py && python3 scripts/check_comments.py && uv run python scripts/versions/check_versions.py && python3 scripts/check_else.py
